request: road trip planner: stops with date and place, expenses split among 4 friends, packing checklist, and fuel cost calculator using km, mileage and petrol price

checklist.item: can add trip stops with place and date
can add expenses with payer and amount
shows total and per-person share among 4
packing checklist with ticks
fuel cost computed from km, mileage and petrol price

program:
app "Road trip" car ocean
table stop place text, on date
table expense payer text, amount money, note text?
table pack item text, packed bool
setting km num = 400 "Distance (km)"
setting mileage num = 12 "Mileage (km per litre)"
setting petrol money = 270 "Petrol price per litre"
"Stops" head
form stop, "Add stop"
each stop sort on as s
  row card swipe remove s
    s.place bold grow
    s.on faint
"Expenses" head
row gap 2
  stat sum(expense.amount), "total"
  stat sum(expense.amount) / 4, "per person (4)"
form expense, "Add expense"
list expense
"Fuel cost" head
stat km / mileage * petrol, "fuel for the trip"
"Packing" head
form pack, "Add item"
each pack as p
  row card swipe remove p
    toggle p.packed
    p.item grow
describe:
Road trip, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- stop: place: text; on: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- expense: payer: text; amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- pack: item: text; packed: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Distance (km)": number, starts at 400; "Mileage (km per litre)": number, starts at 12; "Petrol price per litre": money, starts at 270.
Shows:
- text: "Stops".
- a form to add a stop.
- for each stop sorted by on:
  - a group; a swipe removes the stop, with undo:
    - text: the place of the stop.
    - text: the on of the stop.
- text: "Expenses".
- a big number: the total amount of expense, labelled "total".
- a big number: the total amount of expense divided by 4, labelled "per person 4".
- a form to add a expense.
- a list of expense; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
- text: "Fuel cost".
- a big number: km divided by mileage times petrol, labelled "fuel for the trip".
- text: "Packing".
- a form to add a pack.
- for each pack:
  - a group; a swipe removes the pack, with undo:
    - a tick box for the packed of the pack.
    - text: the item of the pack.

request: Tasbeeh counter. I pick the target: 33, 99 or 100, and it counts taps and tells me when I reach it. Also reset button.

checklist.item: tap button increments count
choice of target 33, 99 or 100
shows when target reached
reset button
remembers a total across sessions

program:
app "Tasbeeh" beads mint
table zikr
state n num = 0
state target num = 33
when n > 0 and n = target notify "Target reached"
row gap 1
  button "33" fill if(target = 33, accent, soft) tap set target = 33
  button "99" fill if(target = 99, accent, soft) tap set target = 99
  button "100" fill if(target = 100, accent, soft) tap set target = 100
draw width 240 tap set n = n + 1 then add zikr
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * min(n, target) / target stroke if(n >= target, good, accent) thick 8
  label 50, 50, n big
if n >= target
  "Target of" target "reached" head color good
button "Reset" tap set n = 0
"Total count ever" count(zikr) faint
describe:
Tasbeeh, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- zikr: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: n, starting at 0; target, starting at 33.
Shows:
- when n is more than 0 and n is target, it shows the notice "Target reached".
- a button "33"; a tap sets target to 33.
- a button "99"; a tap sets target to 99.
- a button "100"; a tap sets target to 100.
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap sets n to n plus 1, then adds a zikr.
- if n is at least target:
  - text: "Target of", target, "reached".
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets n to 0.
- text: "Total count ever", how many zikr entries.

request: scrap dealer (kabari) daily buying: item (iron, paper, plastic, copper), weight kg, rate per kg, seller name. profit when i sell later too

checklist.item: can add a purchase with item type, weight and rate per kg
computes cost as weight times rate
has item choices iron/paper/plastic/copper
shows total spent
has a seller name field

program:
app "Kabari" scale slate
table purchase item pick Iron|Paper|Plastic|Copper, kg num 0.., rate money "Rate per kg", seller text?
table sale item pick Iron|Paper|Plastic|Copper, kg num 0.., rate money "Sale rate per kg"
let spent = sum(purchase, it.kg * it.rate)
let sold = sum(sale, it.kg * it.rate)
row gap 3
  stat spent, "total spent"
  stat sold, "total sales"
form purchase, "Add purchase"
each purchase as p empty "No purchases yet"
  row card tap edit p swipe remove p
    stack grow gap 0
      p.item p.kg "kg" bold
      p.seller faint
    p.kg * p.rate bold
"Selling later" head
form sale, "Add sale"
each options purchase.item as o
  row card
    o bold grow
    "profit" sum(sale where item = o, it.kg * it.rate) - sum(sale where item = o, it.kg) * sum(purchase where item = o, it.kg * it.rate) / max(sum(purchase.kg where item = o), 1) bold
describe:
Kabari, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- purchase: item: one of Iron, Paper, Plastic, Copper; kg: number, at least 0; "Rate per kg": money; seller: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- sale: item: one of Iron, Paper, Plastic, Copper; kg: number, at least 0; "Sale rate per kg": money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- spent is the sum of its kg times its rate over the purchase.
- sold is the sum of its kg times its rate over the sale.
Shows:
- a big number: spent, labelled "total spent".
- a big number: sold, labelled "total sales".
- a form to add a purchase.
- for each purchase:
  - a group; a tap opens the purchase for editing; a swipe removes the purchase, with undo:
    - text: the item of the purchase, the kg of the purchase, "kg".
    - text: the seller of the purchase.
    - text: the kg of the purchase times the rate of the purchase.
- text: "Selling later".
- a form to add a sale.
- for each choice of the item of the purchase:
  - text: the choice.
  - text: "profit", the sum of its kg times its rate over the sale where item is the choice minus the sum of its kg over the sale where item is the choice times the sum of its kg times its rate over the purchase where item is the choice divided by the larger of the total kg of purchase where item is the choice and 1.

request: volleyball match scoreboard: sets to 25 points, win by 2, best of 5 sets. show sets won for each side too.

checklist.item: shows current set score for two teams
tap buttons add a point to each team
shows sets won by each team
has a new set/reset option
indicates when a set is won

program:
app "Volleyball" ball ocean
table rally side pick Home|Away, set num 1..5
state cur num = 1 keep
let hs(s num) = count(rally where set = s and side = Home)
let as_(s num) = count(rally where set = s and side = Away)
let won(a num, b num) = a >= 25 and a - b >= 2
let home = hs(cur)
let away = as_(cur)
let over = won(home, away) or won(away, home)
row gap 2
  stack align center grow
    "Home" bold
    home huge
    count(1..5, won(hs(it), as_(it))) "sets" faint
    button "+1" tap add rally side = Home, set = cur
  stack align center grow
    "Away" bold
    away huge
    count(1..5, won(as_(it), hs(it))) "sets" faint
    button "+1" tap add rally side = Away, set = cur
"Set" cur "of 5" faint
if over
  "Set won" bold color good
  button "Next set" tap set cur = min(cur + 1, 5)
button "Reset match" tap remove all rally then set cur = 1
describe:
Volleyball, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- rally: side: one of Home, Away; set: number, 1 to 5. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- home is how many rally entries where set is cur and side is Home.
- away is how many rally entries where set is cur and side is Away.
- over is the result of home is at least 25 and home minus away is at least 2 or the result of away is at least 25 and away minus home is at least 2.
Remembers while you use it: cur, starting at 1.
Shows:
- text: "Home".
- text: home.
- text: how many of the number from 1 to 5 have the result of how many rally entries where set is the number and side is Home is at least 25 and how many rally entries where set is the number and side is Home minus how many rally entries where set is the number and side is Away is at least 2, "sets".
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a rally with side set to Home, set set to cur.
- text: "Away".
- text: away.
- text: how many of the number from 1 to 5 have the result of how many rally entries where set is the number and side is Away is at least 25 and how many rally entries where set is the number and side is Away minus how many rally entries where set is the number and side is Home is at least 2, "sets".
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a rally with side set to Away, set set to cur.
- text: "Set", cur, "of 5".
- if over:
  - text: "Set won".
  - a button "Next set"; a tap sets cur to the smaller of cur plus 1 and 5.
- a button "Reset match"; a tap removes all rally entries, with one undo, then sets cur to 1.

tapping a seat lets user set a student name

program:
app "Seating" seat slate
table seat rw num 1..5, cl num 1..6, name text
state sr num = 1
state sc num = 1
state nm text
stat count(1..30, count(seat where rw = floor((it - 1) / 6) + 1 and cl = (it - 1) % 6 + 1) > 0), "seats filled"
grid 6 gap 1
  each 1..5 as rr
    each 1..6 as cc
      let cn = last(seat where rw = rr and cl = cc)
      box height 44 radius 8 tap set sr = rr then set sc = cc fill if(count(seat where rw = rr and cl = cc) > 0, accent, soft) stroke if(sr = rr and sc = cc, ink, edge)
        cn.name tiny align center
"Row" sr "seat" sc bold
field nm "Student name"
row gap 1
  button "Seat here" tap add seat rw = sr, cl = sc, name = nm then set nm = ""
  button "Clear seat" tap remove all seat where rw = sr and cl = sc
describe:
Seating, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- seat: rw: number, 1 to 5; cl: number, 1 to 6; name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: sr, starting at 1; sc, starting at 1; nm.
Shows:
- a big number: how many of the number from 1 to 30 have how many seat entries where rw is the result of the number minus 1 divided by 6 rounded down plus 1 and cl is the result of the number minus 1 leaves over when divided by 6 plus 1 is more than 0, labelled "seats filled".
- a grid of 6 columns:
  - for each number from 1 to 5:
    - for each number from 1 to 6:
      - a group; a tap sets sr to the number, then sets sc to the number:
        - text: the name of the cn.
- text: "Row", sr, "seat", sc.

request: meeting time helper for Islamabad, London and New York

checklist.item: input for a time in one city
shows the equivalent time in all three cities
handles the offsets for PKT, London and New York
day change indicated

program:
app "Meeting time" clock ocean
state city pick Islamabad|London|New_York = Islamabad
state t time = 9:00
state bst bool = no
state edt bool = no
let off_src = if(city = Islamabad, 5, if(city = London, if(bst, 1, 0), if(edt, -4, -5)))
let utc = hour(t) - off_src
let shift_ldn = utc + if(bst, 1, 0)
let shift_ny = utc + if(edt, -4, -5)
let shift_isb = utc + 5
let m = if(minute(t) < 10, join("0", minute(t)), join(minute(t)))
"Time is in" faint
choice city
field t "Time"
toggle bst
"London on summer time" faint
toggle edt
"New York on summer time" faint
def zone name text, h num
  row card
    text name bold grow
    text join(h % 24, ":", m) big
    text if(floor(h / 24) > 0, "next day", if(floor(h / 24) < 0, "previous day", "")) faint
zone "Islamabad", shift_isb
zone "London", shift_ldn
zone "New York", shift_ny
describe:
Meeting time, in the ocean colours.
Works out:
- off src is 5 when city is Islamabad, otherwise 1 when bst, otherwise 0 when city is London, otherwise minus 4 when edt, otherwise minus 5.
- utc is the hour of t minus off src.
- shift ldn is utc plus 1 when bst, otherwise 0.
- shift ny is utc plus minus 4 when edt, otherwise minus 5.
- shift isb is utc plus 5.
- m is a value when the minute of t is less than 10, otherwise a value.
Remembers while you use it: city, starting at Islamabad; t, starting at 9:00; bst, starting at no; edt, starting at no.
Shows:
- text: "Time is in".
- a choice of city.
- a box to fill in t, labelled "Time".
- a tick box for bst.
- text: "London on summer time".
- a tick box for edt.
- text: "New York on summer time".
- defines a part called zone, taking name, h.
- the part zone defined in this app, given "Islamabad"; shift isb.
- the part zone defined in this app, given "London"; shift ldn.
- the part zone defined in this app, given "New York"; shift ny.

program:

  let cur = nth(card sort at, i)

      - text: "Tap to flip".
  - a button "Again"; a tap adds a mark with card set to entry number i of card entries sorted by at, result set to Again, then sets flip to no, then sets i to i leaves over when divided by how many card entries plus 1.
